:::{#def-validation-set}
#### Validation set

The **validation set** of a [training/validation/test split](#def-data-splits)
is the [held-out set](#def-held-out-set) of observations indexed by $I_{\text{val}}$,
used to choose among candidate [fitting procedures](#def-fitting-procedure)
fitted to the training set:

$$
\paren{(x_i, y_i)}_{i \in I_{\text{val}}}.
$$ {#eq-validation-set}

:::
